answer: A concrete sybil brake is a bonded kernel of attestations. Each new identity must lock ferrous collateral against a single admission proof, so clones cannot cheaply multiply balances. Before the agent can vote or recruit, N already-established, uncorrelated peers must countersign a record of real work. The stake is the anchor: it refunds only after those signatures finalize, and it is slashed if a tight cluster of lookalike identities later collapses. Farms then pay unrecovered float and cannot buy independent countersigners at scale.
